                             ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance

be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District

symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 15-J in the area bounded by


       West Devon Avenue; North Lawndale Avenue; the alley next south of and
       parallel to West Devon Avenue, and a line 122.80 feet west of and parallel
       lo North I Qwndale Avenue,


to those of a RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.
